SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - MARCH 11, 2015 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
MARCH 11, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The meeting was given by Dr. William “Bill” C. Hundley, II, Pastor, House of Worship
  International.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Boy Scout Troop 693.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.
  Council/Agency Member George Ray
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Carol Chen
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

5.  Public Comments

  None.

6.  Introductions

  Mayor Pulido introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each Councilmember, the Mayor
  Pro Tem and the Mayor introduced their families in attendance.

7.  Recognition and presentations to outgoing Councilmembers Bruce
  Barrows and Joseph Cho

  Presentations were made to outgoing Councilmembers Bruce Barrows and Joseph
  Cho.

8.  Recognition and presentations to outgoing Mayor Pulido

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor Mark Pulido.

9.  City Clerk administers Oath of Office to newly elected Council/Agency
  members

  The City Clerk administered the Oath of Office to newly elected Council/Agency
  members Naresh Solanki, Jim Edwards, and newly re-elected Council member
  Mark Pulido. The Council/Agency members were seated as follows:

  Council/Agency Member Carol K. Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member George Ray
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
 City of Cerritos  March 11, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 2

10.  City Council/Successor Agency reorganization. Selection of Mayor/Chair
  and Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair

  Vida Barone, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Ray presented the qualifications of and nominated Carol K.
  Chen for the office of Mayor/Chair. The nomination was seconded by
  Council/Agency Member Pulido. There were no other nominations. The City Clerk
  closed the nominations and declared Carol K. Chen elected to the office of
  Mayor/Chair by acclamation.

  The office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair was declared vacant by Mayor/Chair Chen
  and she called for nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Edwards presented the qualifications of and nominated
  Council/Agency Member Ray for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair. The
  nomination was seconded by Council/Agency Member Pulido. There were no other
  nominations. The Mayor/Chair closed the nominations and declared George Ray
  elected to the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by acclamation.

11.  Comments from newly designated Mayor/Chair and newly elected
  Council/Agency members

  Mayor/Chair Carol K. Chen made brief comments as did newly elected
  Council/Agency Members Edwards, Pulido, and Solanki.

12.  Comments from City Council/Agency members

  The Council/Agency Members invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:45 p.m.
